summary: Improve bank climate data traceability, financed-emissions checks and disclosure controls. Explore the five-day course and review the outline.
lede: Climate disclosure data operations help banking teams turn portfolio information into traceable reporting data. For sustainability, risk, finance and operations professionals, the course covers PCAF data-quality checks, financed-emissions calculations, source-to-metric lineage and COSO-informed review controls. Spreadsheet exercises cover evidence logging, exception handling and approval workflows, while NGFS scenarios receive an overview-level introduction.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for banking professionals who handle climate data, financed-emissions figures, disclosure controls or the reporting processes that connect them.
modules: Bank Climate Data Ownership and Control
prerequisites: Working familiarity with banking risk, finance, sustainability or reporting processes is expected. No coding or programming is required; exercises use spreadsheet-based calculations and control artefacts.
